an install script runs a small loader that fetches and executes
its entry file is obfuscated code

its entry file gained a capability its previous version did not have

shell_c.reads: group 1 (single-quoted) or group 2 (double-quoted) argument, one level

s6.rule: hook target: API net sink AND host identity AND no exec sink; no 8 KiB cap; grade contributing until measured (R2)

s7.capabilities: net:<API sink> | exec:<EXEC_SINKS> | decode:<DECODE_MARKERS, fromCharCode-run, hex-density, numeric-hex> | obf:_0x-idents (>= s2MinIdents) | cred:<CRED_SOURCES>; url-literal never
s7.rule: per role main/bin: gain = current capability absent from the predecessor same role (bin = union); role READ/ABSENT/NOT_CHECKED; predecessor NOT_CHECKED checked before cold start; cold start NOT_APPLICABLE; refused archive NOT_CHECKED; row names predecessor {version, basis}; runtime predecessor = last version the proxy served (R3). static-checks-1.5 outcome: any role meeting named_condition INDICATOR, else any role NOT_CHECKED NOT_CHECKED, else NONE; a gain not named is NONE and stays on the row
s7.absent_rule: review verdict 2026-10-21: ABSENT (verified absent) only when the archive was read in full; a named candidate not seen otherwise NOT_CHECKED; no candidate on the keep list = none declared; row notes current/predecessor <role>: ... (verified absent); coverage counts verified-absent roles as checked; S1-S5 keep nothing-read = NOT_CHECKED. static-checks-1.5: a role whose predecessor role is ABSENT is never named (predecessor_nonempty false), so no indicator is against an empty baseline; the row keeps the notes
s7.summary_shape: entryFactsSummary -> { version, archive_read_in_full, by_role: { main|bin: { status READ|ABSENT|NOT_CHECKED, caps[], files[], not_checked[], absent? } } } (what the proxy stores per served version, R4)

named_condition.eligible: the predecessor same role status READ (predecessor_nonempty: a file read, not ABSENT; a file read with no capability counts) AND the current role status READ
named_condition.decode_obf: any gain whose class is decode or obf (decode:*, obf:*) except decode_obf_excluded (R9a; any later decode/obf class counts)
named_condition.net_exec: at least one gain net:<API sink> (api_net_sinks names only) AND at least one gain exec:* except exec_excluded, in the same role (R9b)
named_condition.named_gains: the decode/obf gains that count, plus, when net_exec holds, its net and exec gains (exec_excluded never listed); sorted, unique
named_condition.row_fields: by_role.<role>: gains (full set, Function included), predecessor_nonempty, arms, named, not_named (why a gain is not named)
named_condition.excerpt: S7: vs <v> (<basis>): <role> gained <gains> (<arms joined ,>: <named joined ,>)[; ...] [static-checks-1.5]  (named roles only)
named_condition.verification: the 145 stored static-checks-1.4 S7 hit rows (ops .s7-subsets.json: B2 23, compromised_lib Run 3 54, malicious_intent 68) name exactly B2 2 (@firebase/database 0.2.2-0, @velcro/runtime 0.7.0), compromised_lib 17, malicious_intent 28 (npmamzs 1.1.0 included); recon test v613 R3; the check of record is ops' hit-row run with its driver on the v6.13 tree

unchanged_from_1_5: every 1.5 export other than STATIC_CHECKS_VERSION is equal in 1.6 (27 non-function exports, checked in code against the staged v6.13 tree); every section above facts is the 1.5 file's

facts.rule: SHADOW FACTS (operator ruling R11, 2026-10-24): computed and recorded, never read by a row outcome, an indicator, a gate, a class or a notice; S0-S7 unchanged by construction. Re-tiering on any of them is a later ruling.
facts.note: shadow facts (operator ruling R11, 2026-10-24): no outcome, tier or notice depends on them; a fact is read against the file, never a verdict

input_contract.members: every regular-file member of the archive (the installed view: the last duplicate wins), its first 2097152 bytes; binary = a NUL in the first 8000 bytes (any extension); truncated = size beyond the window
input_contract.s5_bodies: for every hook-target path on the keep list, the WHOLE body streamed through makeBase64Share (no bytes kept); the result rides on the not-kept entry as base64 and lands on a FIRING S5 file entry
input_contract.proxy_note: proxy/tar-walk.js keeps the keep list only today: this input (a per-member window and the hook-target body stream) is the owner's to build

rule6.hex_kind: a base64 run whose characters without the = padding are all [0-9a-f] is kind hex
rule6.chars: the regex match length for base64/hex (padding included); for hex-escape, the hex digits (2 per escape)
rule6.distinct_chars: distinct characters of the run without padding; of the hex digits for hex-escape
rule6.magic: base64: Buffer.from(first 24 characters, base64); hex and hex-escape: the first 32 hex digits; then decoded_magic by prefix, else null
rule6.package: runs and files counted in full; by_kind, by_magic (none for null), under_diversity_ref (distinct_chars < diversityRef); the first `listed` runs listed with their path

rule7.run: a run of at least 400 alphabet bytes counts with up to two = bytes directly after it; any other byte (or a third =) ends a run; an alphabet byte after = starts a new run
rule7.share: base64_bytes / bytes, Number(x.toFixed(3)); 0 for an empty body
rule7.magic: decided once, when the FIRST run reaches 400 bytes: decoded_magic of Buffer.from(that run's first 24 characters, base64), else null
rule7.s5_row: a FIRING S5 file entry carries base64_share and base64_magic; without a streamed body both null and base64_note "body not streamed: base64 share not checked"; a non-firing entry carries none

s8a.count: lines of the window (split on \n) with a match, per member; the package splits rest / excluded into lines and files with a hit, and lists the excluded files with a hit

s8d.rule: a text names a dir (dirs sorted, unique: .<name> or .config/<name>) AND matches a write marker (marker-list order); the redirect only for hook commands and shell-script paths; files listed with their keep-list roles (else ["module"]), then hook commands

s8h.rule: a member with an encoded run has the encoding class (token encoded-run); an install hook (preinstall, install, postinstall) is an exec surface; present (no_io_surface false, CHECKED) on any token or hook whatever was not read; NONE (true) only when the archive was read in full and every member read as text within the window; else NOT_CHECKED, no_io_surface null, with the reason

facts.block_shape: checks.static_checks.facts = { version, note, status, encoded_runs, excluded_paths, agent_config_writes, io_surface }; without members: { version, note, status NOT_CHECKED, reason "no member facts supplied" }
